(a) The mass flow rate is given by
\[ \dot{m} = \frac{\pi \times \left( 0.30 \text{ m}\right)^2 \times 40 \times 10^3 \text{ m}}{60 \times 10^3} = 0.0303 \text{ kg/s} \]

(b) The Reynolds number is given by
\[ Re_{\text{R}} = \frac{\rho \times u \times D}{\mu} = \frac{p_{\text{in}}}{\rho_{\text{in}} \times g \times \frac{D^2}{4}} \]
Since the flow is isothermal, the static pressure is constant, and the density is constant, we can simplify the equation as
\[ Re_{\text{R}} = \frac{\rho \times u \times D}{\mu} = \frac{\frac{p_{\text{in}}}{\rho_{\text{in}}}}{\frac{p_{\text{out}}}{\rho_{\text{out}}} \times \frac{D^2}{4}} = \frac{\frac{p_{\text{in}}}{\rho_{\text{in}}}}{\frac{p_{\text{out}}}{\rho_{\text{out}}} \times \frac{D^2}{4}} = \frac{4 \times \frac{p_{\text{in}}}{\rho_{\text{in}}}}{\frac{p_{\text{out}}}{\rho_{\text{out}}} \times \frac{D^2}{4}} \]
Since the flow is isothermal, we can use the ideal gas equation to simplify the equation as
\[ \rho_{\text{in}} = \frac{p_{\text{in}}}{R_{\text{in}} T_{\text{in}}} = \frac{p_{\text{in}}}{R_{\text{in}} \times 288 \text{ K}} \]
\[ \rho_{\text{out}} = \frac{p_{\text{out}}}{R_{\text{out}} T_{\text{out}}} = \frac{p_{\text{out}}}{R_{\text{out}} \times 288 \text{ K}} \]
Substituting the values, we get
\[ Re_{\text{R}} = \frac{4 \times \frac{5.0 \times 10^6}{0.0289}}{\frac{3.0 \times 10^6}{0.0289} \times \left( \frac{10^{-3}}{4}\right)^2} = 1.36 \]

(c) The Darcy friction factor is given by
\[ f = \frac{64}{\left( \frac{\mu}{\rho} \right) \left( \frac{D}{4} \right)^2} = \frac{64}{\left( \frac{1.1 \times 10^{-5}}{0.0289} \right) \left( \frac{0.3}{4} \right)^2} = 0.612 \]

(d) The total head is given by the equation
\[ h_{\text{total}} = \frac{h_{\text{atm}}}{\gamma} + \frac{\left( \frac{P_{\text{out}} - P_{\text{in}}}{\rho \times g} \right)}{2 \times \log_{10} \left( \frac{\rho_{\text{out}}}{\rho_{\text{in}}} \right)} \]
\[ h_{\text{total}} = \frac{1}{\gamma} \left( \frac{P_{\text{out}} - P_{\text{in}}}{\rho_{\text{out}} \times g} \right) + \frac{1}{2 \times \log_{10} \left( \frac{\rho_{\text{out}}}{\rho_{\text{in}}} \right)} \]

\[ h_{\text{total}} = \frac{1}{1.01} \left( \frac{3.0 \times 10^6 - 5.0 \times 10^6}{0.0289 \times 9.81 \times 40,000} \right) + \frac{1}{2 \times \log_{10} \left( \frac{0.0289}{0.0289} \right)} \]
\[ h_{\text{total}} = 4.36 \text{ m} \]
